doc: Reduce a diagonal channel-only approximation and broadcast it over output channels and stride tiles; add bias.
name: diagonal_kernel_primitive
reference:
def fn(x, **params):
    w = module.weight
    n = min(params['cin'], params['cout'])
    d = w[torch.arange(n), torch.arange(n)].mean(dim=(-1, -2))
    s = (x[:, :n] * d.view(1, n, 1, 1)).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
    y = s.expand(-1, params['cout'], -1, -1)
    y = y.repeat_interleave(params['stride'], -2).repeat_interleave(params['stride'], -1)
    return y + module.bias.view(1, -1, 1, 1)
